subject: English
status: Original practice content written by Claude Code (Opus 5.5) on 2026-11-06 to mirror the official paper's structure, task types, timing and level. Not copied from БҮТ papers. Teacher review pending. Not used on the website.

tasks.title: Grammar
tasks.instructions: Read the following sentences. Choose the correct answer for each gap. /12 x 1 = 12 points/

questions.stem: She is ___ honest person, and she always tells ___ truth.
questions.explanation: “honest” үгийн “h” дуудагддаггүй тул эгшиг авиагаар эхэлж “an” авна; “tell the truth” (үнэн хэлэх) нь тогтсон хэллэг тул хоёр дахь зайд “the” орж “an / the” болно.

questions.stem: Our lesson starts ___ 8:30 ___ the morning.
questions.explanation: Цагийн яг агшинд “at” (“at 8:30”), өдрийн хэсгийг заахад “in” (“in the morning”) угтвар үг хэрэглэдэг тул “at / in”.

questions.stem: Dorj speaks English very ___.
questions.explanation: “speaks” үйл үгийг тодотгох дайвар үг хэрэгтэй; “good” тэмдэг нэрийн дайвар үгийн хэлбэр нь “well” тул “speaks English very well” (англиар маш сайн ярьдаг).

questions.stem: There ___ some milk in the fridge, but the eggs ___ getting old.
questions.explanation: “milk” тоологдохгүй нэр үг тул ганц тооны “is”, “the eggs” олон тоо тул “are” орж “is / are” болно; өндөг хуучирч байгаа нь одоо үргэлжилж буй цагаар (“getting old”) илэрхийлэгджээ.

questions.stem: We ___ each other since we were children.
questions.explanation: “since we were children” (хүүхэд байхаасаа хойш) нь одоо хүртэл үргэлжилж буй байдлыг заах тул одоо төгссөн цаг “have known”; “know” үйл үг үргэлжилсэн хэлбэр авдаггүй.

questions.stem: I ___ along the street when I ___ an old friend.
questions.explanation: Гудамжаар алхаж явсан нь үргэлжилж байсан үйл (“was walking”), найзтайгаа таарсан нь түүний дундуур болсон богино үйл (“met”) тул өнгөрсөн үргэлжилсэн ба энгийн цаг хослоно.

questions.stem: Nobody called while I was out, ___?
questions.explanation: “Nobody” нь утгаараа үгүйсгэл тул хавсралт асуулт эерэг болно; “nobody”, “somebody” зэргийг хавсралт асуултад “they” төлөөний үгээр орлуулдаг тул “did they”.

questions.stem: By the time you arrive, we ___ dinner.
questions.explanation: “By the time you arrive” (чамайг ирэх үед) гэдэг нь ирээдүйн тодорхой агшнаас өмнө дуусах үйлийг заах тул ирээдүйн төгссөн цаг “will have finished” хэрэглэнэ.

questions.stem: If I ___ a car, I ___ you to the airport.
questions.explanation: Машин байхгүй боловч байсан бол гэж төсөөлж буй тул 2-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр: “If I … a car” хэсэгт өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг “had”, гол хэсэгт “would drive” орно.

questions.stem:
Tourist: Where ___ this carpet made?
Seller: It ___ by hand in a small village near Kharkhorin.
questions.explanation: Хивсийг хүн гараар (“by hand”) хийсэн, хивс өөрөө үйлдэгч биш тул асуулт, хариулт хоёуланд өнгөрсөн цагийн үйлдэгдэх хэв орно: “Where was this carpet made?”, “It was made by hand”.

questions.stem: We sat at a ___ table.
questions.explanation: Тэмдэг нэрийг үнэлгээ (“nice”) → хэмжээ (“big”) → нас (“old”) → материал (“wooden”) дарааллаар байрлуулдаг тул “nice, big, old, wooden”.

questions.stem: He failed the exam ___ he had studied very hard.
questions.explanation: “He failed the exam” ба “he had studied very hard” гэсэн эсрэгцсэн хоёр санааг “although” (хэдийгээр … ч) холбоно; “despite”, “because of” нь бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн өмнө ордоггүй.

tasks.title: Task 1
tasks.instructions: Read the sentences and choose the correct word for each blank. /10 x 2 = 20 points/

questions.stem: My little brother is always asking questions about everything. He's very ___.
questions.explanation: “always asking questions about everything” (бүх зүйлийн талаар байнга асуудаг) хүүхдийг “curious” (сониуч) гэнэ; “anxious” нь түгшсэн, “modest” нь даруу гэсэн утгатай.

questions.stem: It is ___ to drink enough water during hot weather.
questions.explanation: “It is … to drink enough water” бүтцэд утгаараа “important” (чухал) тохирно; “impossible” (боломжгүй), “impatient” (тэвчээргүй) зэрэг нь өгүүлбэрийн санаатай зөрчилдөнө.

questions.stem: The young man was ___; he couldn't read or write.
questions.explanation: “he couldn't read or write” (уншиж, бичиж чаддаггүй) гэсэн тайлбар нь “illiterate” (бичиг үсэг мэддэггүй) гэдгийн яг тодорхойлолт; “illegible” нь гар бичмэлийн тухай хэрэглэгдэнэ.

questions.stem: Meditation is a ___ practice for many Buddhists.
questions.explanation: Бясалгал (“Meditation”) нь Буддын шашинтнуудын сэтгэл санааны, шашны дадал тул “spiritual” (сүнслэг); “financial” (санхүүгийн), “chemical” (химийн) нь утга зохицохгүй.

questions.stem: The teacher gave us a ___ of three essay topics.
questions.explanation: “a … of three essay topics” гэдэг нь гурван сэдвээс сонгох боломж өгсөн гэсэн утгатай тул “choice” (сонголт); “give someone a choice” нь хэн нэгэнд сонгох эрх өгөх.

questions.stem: We ran ___ of bread, so I went to the shop.
questions.explanation: “run out of” хэлц үйл үг нь ямар нэг зүйл дуусах гэсэн утгатай; талх дууссан учраас “so I went to the shop” буюу дэлгүүр явсан.

questions.stem: Please fill ___ this form and sign it at the bottom.
questions.explanation: Маягт бөглөхийг “fill in a form” гэж хэлдэг; “and sign it at the bottom” (доор нь гарын үсэг зур) гэсэн нь бичиг баримт бөглөх тухай болохыг баталж байна.

questions.stem: For the picnic we bought a ___ of grapes and a ___ of lemonade.
questions.explanation: Усан үзэм багцаараа (“a bunch of grapes”), ундаа лонхтой (“a bottle of lemonade”) зарагддаг тул “bunch / bottle”.

questions.stem: Marco Polo made a long ___ from Venice to China in the 13th century.
questions.explanation: Венециэс Хятад хүртэлх урт аяллыг “journey” гэнэ, “make a journey” нь аялал хийх гэсэн хоршоо; “route” нь замын чиглэл, “ride” нь богино унаа.

questions.stem: After forty years of work, my grandfather decided to ___.
questions.explanation: “After forty years of work” (40 жил ажилласны дараа) өвөө тэтгэвэрт гарахаар шийдсэн тул “retire” (тэтгэвэрт гарах); “recover” нь эдгэрэх, “remove” нь зайлуулах гэсэн утгатай.

tasks.title: Task 2
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct word to complete the conversations. /3 x 2 = 6 points/

questions.stem:
Mother: Why did you tidy your room without being asked?
Son: I wanted to ___ you!
questions.explanation: Хүү өрөөгөө “without being asked” (хэлүүлэлгүй) цэвэрлэсэн нь ээжийгээ гайхшруулж баярлуулах санаа тул “surprise”; “disappoint” (урмыг хугалах), “annoy” (бухимдуулах) нь сөрөг утгатай.

questions.stem:
Sara: Your cake looks amazing! Can you tell me how you made it?
Gerel: Sure, I'll send you the ___.
questions.explanation: Бялууг “how you made it” буюу хэрхэн хийснийг хоолны жор (“recipe”) тайлбарладаг; “prescription” нь эмчийн бичсэн эмийн жор, “receipt” нь төлбөрийн баримт.

questions.stem:
Reporter: There has been no rain here for over a year.
Farmer: Yes, this ___ has killed most of our crops.
questions.explanation: “no rain here for over a year” (жил гаруй бороо ороогүй) гэсэн нь ган гачиг буюу “drought” үзэгдлийг тодорхойлно; “flood” нь үер, “blizzard” нь цасан шуурга.

tasks.title: Task 3
tasks.instructions: Choose the correct prefix to build the antonym of the adjectives. /2 x 2 = 4 points/

questions.explanation: “r” үсгээр эхэлсэн тэмдэг нэрт “ir-” угтвар залгаж эсрэг утгатай үг үүсгэдэг: “regular” (тогтмол) → “irregular” (тогтмол бус, жигд бус).
“kind” (эелдэг, сайхан сэтгэлтэй) гэдгийн эсрэг утгатай үг нь “un-” угтвартай “unkind” (сэтгэлгүй, эелдэг бус).

tasks.title: Conversation 1
tasks.instructions: Read the conversations and choose the best answers for them. There are 2 blanks in the conversation (28-29). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /5 x 2 = 10 points/
tasks.text:
Receptionist: Good evening, welcome to the Blue Sky Hotel.
Guest: Good evening. I have a reservation for two nights. My name is Lee.
Receptionist: Let me check... Yes, Mr. Lee, a double room. 28. _________
Guest: Here you are.
Receptionist: Thank you. Your room is 512, on the fifth floor. Breakfast is served from seven to ten.
Guest: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
Receptionist: Yes, the password is on the card. Is there anything else?
Guest: 29. _________
Receptionist: Certainly. The airport bus leaves from the front door every hour.

options.B: How many nights would you like?
options.E: May I see your passport, please?

questions.explanation: Зочин дараагийн мөрөнд “Here you are.” гэж ямар нэг зүйл өгсөн тул хүлээн авагч бичиг баримт хүссэн байх ёстой: “May I see your passport, please?”

options.A: No, I don't have any luggage.
options.D: Yes, how can I get to the airport on Wednesday?

questions.explanation: Хүлээн авагч “The airport bus leaves from the front door every hour” гэж хариулсан тул зочин нисэх буудал руу хэрхэн очихыг асуусан: “Yes, how can I get to the airport on Wednesday?”

questions.stem: Where is the conversation taking place?
questions.explanation: “welcome to the Blue Sky Hotel”, “I have a reservation for two nights” гэсэн хэллэгүүд яриа “At a hotel reception desk” буюу зочид буудлын хүлээн авах ширээн дээр болж байгааг харуулна.

tasks.title: Conversation 2
tasks.text:
Coach: Well done, everyone. Second place in the national championship!
Naraa: Second place? We trained for six months to win first place.
Coach: I know, but the other team was very strong. You should be proud.
Naraa: I suppose so... but I really wanted that gold medal.
Bilguun: Don't worry, Naraa. Next year we'll win. I'm sure of it! We just need more practice.

questions.stem: Naraa feels ___ about the result.
questions.explanation: Нараа “We trained for six months to win first place”, “I really wanted that gold medal” гэж хэлсэн нь хоёрдугаар байранд сэтгэл дундуур буюу “disappointed” байгааг харуулна.

questions.stem: Bilguun is ___ about next year.
questions.explanation: Билгүүн “Next year we'll win. I'm sure of it!” гэж ирэх жил ялна гэдэгтээ бүрэн итгэж байгаа тул “confident” (итгэлтэй).

tasks.title: Passage 1
tasks.instructions: Read the passage and choose the correct answers. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
Every summer, Mongolians celebrate Naadam, the country's biggest national festival. It is often called the 'three games of men' because it includes wrestling, horse racing and archery. Today, however, women also take part in archery, and girls often ride in the horse races.

The festival has a very long history. Hundreds of years ago, Naadam was a way for warriors to show their strength and skill. Later, it became a celebration held after religious ceremonies. Today, the main Naadam takes place in Ulaanbaatar every year on 11-13 July.

Horse racing is perhaps the most surprising event for visitors. The riders are children, usually between five and thirteen years old, because **they** weigh much less than adults. The races cross the open steppe over distances of up to 30 kilometres. The horses, not the riders, are the real stars, and the winning horse is <u>praised</u> in a special song.

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: It is about warriors in ancient Mongolia.
options.B: It is about how children learn to ride horses.
options.C: It is about the history and main events of a Mongolian festival.
options.D: It is about why visitors come to Ulaanbaatar.
options.E: It is about the rules of Mongolian wrestling.

questions.explanation: Эх бүхэлдээ “the country's biggest national festival” болох Наадмын урт түүх, “wrestling, horse racing and archery” гэсэн гол төрлүүд, морин уралдааны онцлогийн тухай өгүүлнэ.

questions.stem: Children ride in the horse races because ___
questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд хүүхдүүд уралдаанд унадаг шалтгааныг “because they weigh much less than adults” гэж тайлбарласан; өөрөөр хэлбэл “they are not heavy” буюу тэд хөнгөн.

questions.stem: The pronoun "they" in bold in paragraph 3 refers to ___.
questions.explanation: “The riders are children … because they weigh much less than adults” өгүүлбэрт “they” нь өмнө нь дурдсан “children” буюу хүүхэд унаачдыг заана.

questions.stem: The word "praised" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.explanation: “the winning horse is praised in a special song” гэдэгт “praised” нь магтах, сайшаах гэсэн утгатай тул хамгийн ойр утгатай нь “admired” (биширсэн); “criticized” нь эсрэг утгатай.

tasks.title: Passage 2
tasks.instructions: Read the text and choose the correct answers. There are 3 blanks in the text (37-39). Fill in the blanks from the given options. /4 x 2 = 8 points/
tasks.text:
Dear Uncle Bat,

Greetings from Switzerland! We 37. _________ here on Sunday after a long flight, and the mountains are even more beautiful than in the photos. Every morning we take a cable car to the top and ski down. Mom fell twice on the first day, but she's getting better!

The village is small and quiet, and our hotel has a wonderful view of the lake. Yesterday we tried cheese fondue, which is a traditional Swiss dish. Tomorrow we're going to take a train 38. _________ the mountains to a famous glacier.

We 39. _________ home next Friday. I'll bring you some Swiss chocolate!

Best wishes,
Ariunaa

questions.explanation: “on Sunday after a long flight” гэж өнгөрсөн тодорхой цагт ирснээ хэлж байгаа тул өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг “arrived” хэрэглэнэ.
Галт тэрэг уулсын дундуур нэвтэрч явахыг “through” угтвар үг илэрхийлнэ: “a train … the mountains” гэдэгт “under” (доогуур), “among” (дунд) утга зохицохгүй.
“next Friday” гэсэн ирээдүйн тодорхой төлөвлөгөөг (нислэг аль хэдийн товлогдсон) одоо үргэлжилж буй цагаар илэрхийлдэг тул “are flying”.

questions.stem: Ariunaa's family is ___.

options.B: visiting Uncle Bat in the mountains
options.D: on a skiing holiday in Switzerland

questions.explanation: Ариунаа Швейцарьт ирээд “Every morning we take a cable car to the top and ski down” гэж бичсэн тул гэр бүл нь тэнд цанын амралтаар явж байна.

tasks.instructions: Read the questions (a-e) and complete them with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.text: Why ___ you so late this morning?
items.explanation: “this morning” (өнөө өглөө) аль хэдийн өнгөрсөн бөгөөд “late” тэмдэг нэрийн өмнө “be” үйл үг хэрэгтэй тул “you” өгүүлэгдэхүүнд тохирох өнгөрсөн цагийн “were” орно.

items.label: b
items.text: What ___ your sister like? Is she friendly?
items.explanation: “What … like?” гэж хэн нэгний зан чанар, төрхийг асуудаг; “your sister” ганц тоо бөгөөд “Is she friendly?” гэж одоогийн байдлаар асууж байгаа тул “is”.

items.label: c
items.text: How many countries ___ you visited so far?
items.explanation: “so far” (одоог хүртэл) нь одоо төгссөн цагийн тэмдэг үг тул “How many countries have you visited …?” гэж “have” орно.

items.label: d
items.text: What ___ you do if you lost your passport abroad?
items.explanation: “if you lost your passport abroad” гэсэн бодит бус нөхцөлд гол хэсэг нь “would” авдаг: “What would you do …?”

items.label: e
items.text: When ___ the film start last night?
items.explanation: “last night” өнгөрсөн цагийг заадаг бөгөөд “start” үндсэн хэлбэртээ байгаа тул туслах үйл үг “did” орно.

tasks.instructions: Read the incomplete sentences (a-e) and fill in the gaps with the appropriate words (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “2015” гэх мэт үйл эхэлсэн цаг хугацааны цэгийн өмнө “since” хэрэглэх бөгөөд энэ нь “I've lived here …” шиг одоо төгссөн цагтай хамт ирдэг.

items.label: b
items.text: She has been ill ___ three days.
items.explanation: “three days” нь хугацааны үргэлжлэлийг заах тул “for” (…-ийн турш) хэрэглэнэ; эхэлсэн цэгийн өмнө л “since” ордог.

items.label: c
items.text: We moved to Darkhan ten years ___.
items.explanation: “ten years” гэсэн хугацааны дараа ирж одоогоос өмнөх үйлийг заадаг үг нь “ago” (…-ийн өмнө); өгүүлбэр өнгөрсөн энгийн цагт (“moved”) байгаа нь үүнийг баталж байна.

items.label: d
items.text: Someone stole my bag ___ I was sleeping on the train.
items.explanation: “I was sleeping on the train” гэсэн бүтэн өгүүлбэрийн өмнө “while” (…-ж байх үед) ордог; “during” нь зөвхөн нэр үгийн өмнө хэрэглэгдэнэ.

items.label: e
items.explanation: Одоо төгссөн цагийн асуултын төгсгөлд “yet” (аль хэдийн, одоохондоо) орж үйл дууссан эсэхийг асууна: “Have you finished your homework …?”

tasks.instructions: Match the beginnings of the sentences (a-e) with the appropriate endings (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “as soon as” (…-нгуут) нь ирээдүйг заасан ч одоо энгийн цагтай хэрэглэгддэг: “I'll call you … as soon as I get home.”

items.label: b
items.explanation: “so” + тэмдэг нэр + “that” нь үр дүнг харуулна: “She was so tired … that she fell asleep on the bus.” (автобусанд унтчихсан).

items.label: c
items.explanation: “Unless” нь “if … not” (…-хгүй бол) гэсэн утгатай тул ирээдүйн үр дагавар “… you'll miss the last train.” тохирно: яарахгүй бол сүүлийн галт тэрэгнээс хоцорно.

items.label: d
items.text: The book that you lent me …
items.explanation: “The book that you lent me” бол тодотгол өгүүлбэртэй өгүүлэгдэхүүн бөгөөд түүнд үйл үг дутуу байгаа тул “… was really exciting.” (үнэхээр сонирхолтой байсан).

items.label: e
items.explanation: Гэртээ үлдэх шийдвэрийн шалтгааныг “because” хэсэг тайлбарлана: “We decided to stay inside … because it was snowing heavily.”

choices.text: … that she fell asleep on the bus.
… as soon as I get home.

tasks.instructions: Match the sports (a-e) with their descriptions (1-7). /5 x 1 = 5 points/ (5 min)

items.label: a
items.explanation: “Archery” (сур харваа) нь нум сумаар бай онох спорт тул “… is a sport in which you shoot arrows at a target.”

items.label: b
items.explanation: “Wrestling” (бөх) нь хоёр хүн бие биенээ газарт унагах гэж барилддаг спорт: “… is a sport in which two people try to throw each other to the ground.”

items.label: c
items.explanation: “Basketball” (сагсан бөмбөг) нь багийн тоглоом бөгөөд өндөрт байрлах сагс руу бөмбөг шиддэг: “… is a team sport in which players throw a ball through a high net.”

items.label: d
items.explanation: “Swimming” (усан сэлэлт) нь гар, хөлөө ашиглан усанд урагшилдаг спорт: “… is a sport in which you move through water using your arms and legs.”

items.label: e
items.explanation: “Chess” (шатар) нь ноён, бэрс, хүүтэй, хоёр хүн тоглодог хөлгийн тоглоом тул “… is a board game for two players with kings, queens and pawns.”

choices.text: … is a board game for two players with kings, queens and pawns.

tasks.title: Listening
tasks.instructions: You are going to listen to a woman interviewing a student about sport. Read each question and choose the correct answer. You have 1 minute and 30 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen to the passage twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
tasks.audioScript:
Woman: Hi, I'm from the city sports centre. We're asking young people about their sporting habits. Do you have a few minutes?
Boy: Yes, of course.
Woman: Great. What's your name?
Boy: Tom Weston. That's W-E-S-T-O-N.
Woman: And how old are you, Tom?
Boy: I'm seventeen.
Woman: What sports do you do?
Boy: Mainly running. I'm training for my first marathon in October. I also swim, and I play table tennis with my dad.
Woman: How often do you train?
Boy: Five times a week now. When I started two years ago, I only ran once a week, just for fun.
Woman: Do you go to watch sports events?
Boy: Not really. Tickets for football matches are too expensive for me, so I watch them on TV.
Woman: What do you plan to do after school?
Boy: I want to study sports science at university and become a coach.
Woman: Good luck. And what are you going to do now?
Boy: I'm going to the park to meet my running club. We do a long run every Saturday.

questions.stem: Why is the woman talking to Tom?

options.A: She wants him to join a running club.
options.B: She is writing about the marathon.
options.D: She is selling tickets for a football match.
options.E: She is doing a survey about young people's sporting habits.

questions.explanation: Эмэгтэй “We're asking young people about their sporting habits” гэж хэлсэн тул тэр залуучуудын спортын дадал зуршлын талаар судалгаа хийж байна.

questions.stem: What is the student's name?
questions.explanation: Хүү “Tom Weston. That's W-E-S-T-O-N.” гэж үсэглэсэн тул “Tom WESTON”; “WESTERN”, “WESTOWN” зэрэгт илүү үсэг нэмэгдсэн байна.

questions.stem: When Tom started running, he trained ___.
questions.explanation: Том “When I started two years ago, I only ran once a week, just for fun” гэсэн; одоо долоо хоногт таван удаа бэлтгэл хийдэг.

questions.stem: Why doesn't Tom go to football matches?
questions.explanation: Том “Tickets for football matches are too expensive for me” гэсэн тул тасалбар үнэтэй учир тоглолтыг зурагтаар үздэг.

questions.stem: What is Tom going to do after the interview?

options.C: Play table tennis with his dad.
options.E: Meet his running club in the park.

questions.explanation: Төгсгөлд Том “I'm going to the park to meet my running club” гэж хэлсэн; тэд Бямба гараг бүр урт зайн гүйлт хийдэг.

questions.stem: Tom does all of the following activities EXCEPT ___.
questions.explanation: Том гүйлт, усан сэлэлт хийж, аавтайгаа ширээний теннис тоглодог, марафонд бэлддэг ч хөлбөмбөгийг зөвхөн “I watch them on TV” гэж зурагтаар үздэг тул багт тоглодоггүй.
